entries.title: Isaiah 10:1
segments: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the scribes [who] write toil;

entries.title: Isaiah 10:2
segments: to turn aside the needy from judgment, and to steal the right from the poor of My people, that widows may be their prey, and they rob the orphans!

entries.title: Isaiah 10:3
segments: And what will you do in the day of judgment and in destruction? It comes from afar? To whom will you flee for help? And where will you leave your glory?

entries.title: Isaiah 10:4
segments: Surely they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. In all this His hand is not turned away, but His hand [is] stretched out still.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:5
segments: Woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger! And the staff in their hand is My fury.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:6
segments: I will send him against an ungodly nation, and against the people of My wrath. I will command him to take the plunder, and to strip off the spoil, and to trample them like the mud of the streets.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:7
segments: Yet he does not plan this, nor does his heart think so. For [it is] in his heart to destroy and cut off not a few nations.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:8
segments: For he says, [Are] not my commanders all like kings?

entries.title: Isaiah 10:9
segments: [Is] not Calno like Carchemish? [Is] not Hamath like Arpad? [Is] not Samaria like Damascus?

entries.title: Isaiah 10:10
segments: As my hand has reached to the kingdoms of the idols, and their graven images [more than] Jerusalem's and Samaria's;

entries.title: Isaiah 10:11
segments: shall I not do to Jerusalem and her idols as I have done to Samaria and her idols?

entries.title: Isaiah 10:12
segments: And it will be, when the Lord has broken off all His work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the proud heart of the king of Assyria and the glory of his high looks.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:13
segments: For he says, By the strength of my hand I have done [it], and by my wisdom; for I am wise. And I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the people like a strong man.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:14
segments: And my hand has found as a nest the riches of the people; and as one gathers eggs [that are] left, I have gathered all the earth; and there was none who moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:15
segments: Shall the axe boast itself against him who chops with it? Shall the saw magnify itself against him who moves it? As [if] the rod [could] wave those who lift [itself] up! As [if] a staff could raise [what is] not wood!

entries.title: Isaiah 10:16
segments: Therefore the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, shall send leanness among his fat ones; and under his glory [He] shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:17
segments: And the light of Israel shall be as a fire, and His holy One as a flame; and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:18
segments: And it shall burn up the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body; and they shall be as when a sick one faints.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:19
segments: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a boy might write them.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:20
segments: And it shall be in that day, the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob, shall never again lean on him who struck them; but truly lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:21
segments: The remnant shall return, the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:22
segments: For though Your people Israel are like the sand of the sea, [yet] a remnant of them shall return; the full end which is decreed shall overflow [with] righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:23
segments: For the Lord Jehovah of hosts shall make a full end, as ordained, in the midst of all the land.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:24
segments: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah of hosts, O my people who dwell [in] Zion, do not fear Assyria. He shall strike you with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against you, in the way of Egypt.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:25
segments: But yet a little while, and the fury shall cease, and My anger [shall be] in their ruin.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:26
segments: And the LORD of hosts shall stir up a whip on him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb; and [as] His rod was on the sea, so shall He lift it up in the way of Egypt.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:27
segments: And it shall be, in that day his burden shall be taken away from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:28
segments: He has come to Aiath, he has passed to Migron; at Michmash he has stored his baggage;

entries.title: Isaiah 10:29
segments: they have gone over the passage; they have bedded down at Geba; Ramah is afraid, Gibeah of Saul has fled.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:30
segments: Lift up your voice, daughter of heaps; shriek with your voice; bow Laish, afflicted of Anathoth.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:31
segments: Madmenah wanders; the people of Gebim take refuge.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:32
segments: Yet [he] shall remain in Nob today; [he] shall shake his hand [against] the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:33
segments: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror; and the lofty ones [shall be] cut down, and the proud shall be humbled.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:34
segments: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
